content_md:
# Blygger update

Did a lot of work today on blygger. 

## Spec

1. Finished bringing reference client up to full 0.3 compliance and froze v 0.3. People building production clients should build against this.
1. Wrote the living v 0.4 spec. People who want to help test the unfrozen spec can build against this. It’s a moving target that gets revised as the reference client implementation finds issues.

## Reference client, now named Blygger Studio

1. Lots of work, mostly invisible. 
1. There is now an update alert mechanism that alerts users about new version
1. There is a packaged templated version with deployment instructions

## Backend

1. Spec and ref client are now separate repos
1. Issue pipelines now exist. You can file issues against either the spec or the reference client. Let your agent decide which.
1. Several technical notes for stuff the protocol will remain agnostic about, but are features people want to build, are cued up and will be published in the next couple of days

## Sites

1. All queued new blygs approved on blygger.com
1. Blygger.org has updated documentation and the newly frozen v0.3 specs\
